instruction: Set up local folders in Thunderbird for RESEARCH and PUBLICATIONS.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird (RESEARCH and PUBLICATIONS). Evaluator checks for both folder files and .msf metadata files. Same complexity as original task with different folder names.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for RESEARCH and PUBLICATIONS folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses ls -R to capture complete state of Thunderbird Local Folders directory
Complete coverage: checks for both RESEARCH and PUBLICATIONS folders as required by instruction
Appropriate verification method: verifies both .msf metadata files and folder directories (Thunderbird creates both for local folders)
Regex patterns are semantically correct: \bRESEARCH\.msf\b matches metadata file, \bRESEARCH/?(?!\.msf) matches folder while excluding .msf
check_list metric correctly requires ALL expected patterns to match before returning 1.0
State accessibility ensured via postconfig execution of ls command, output cached properly
No semantic or logical issues identified
